prompt:
A landscape 16:9 desktop website first viewport of KONSTANZ, a Konstanz nightlife discovery site. This is a usable website UI whose layout IS stacked WPA National Park silkscreen poster planes — not a poster hanging on a wall, not a framed print, not a photograph of a poster. Browser window filled edge-to-edge by the page. No chrome mockup of a Mac window unless necessary; the page itself is the image.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as layered flat silkscreen planes that crop off the left, right, and top edges (planes continue beyond the viewport; the lake summit still survives in frame):

1. SKY PLANE (top ~35%): a wide horizontal swath of flat teal ink #2A7A8C. Simple geometric sun or moon disc in cream #F3E6C8. Maybe a few simplified pine-tree silhouettes in dark pine #1F4A3C along the far shore. No clouds with gradients. No neon. No glass. No photography.

2. LAKE PLANE (the product, the summit of the composition): Bodensee as stacked horizontal bands of teal #2A7A8C and pine #1F4A3C, like WPA water — flat overlapping silkscreen shapes suggesting ripples and the far Swiss shore as a low pine ridgeline. The lake occupies the visual center and is the largest plane. Water is the hero, not a background photo behind cards.

3. PROMENADE PLANE (midground): a cream-stock #F3E6C8 and ochre #C47A3A walkway/quay along the water, seen in simplified WPA perspective — a few flat building silhouettes, a pier, lamp posts as simple geometric stems. THIS is where tonight's nights live as labeled objects ON the promenade, not as a CSS card grid overlaid on a poster. Four night labels sit on or beside midground architecture like WPA map labels, in blocky geometric condensed caps, cream or ochre ink:
   - TECHNO FRIDAY · BLECHNEREI · 23:00
   - STUDENT NIGHT · CLUB XYZ · 22:00
   - LIVE MUSIC NIGHT · BAR CENTRAL · 21:00
   - HIP-HOP PARTY · HAFENBAR · 22:30
Each night is a small silkscreen pictogram or building mass with its name/time/venue as a midground label the visitor can actually read. Doors times are scannable. No ticket prices. No Buy buttons. No auth.

4. FOREGROUND PLANE: a darker pine #1F4A3C band of near shore, a simplified railing or quay edge, maybe a bicycle or figure as a flat two-color silhouette — cropped by the bottom caption bar.

5. CAPTION BAR (bottom of the viewport, like a WPA poster caption band): a solid pine #1F4A3C or ochre #C47A3A horizontal bar. Huge blocky geometric sans-serif caps, cream #F3E6C8, one imperative only: GO OUT / TONIGHT  (two lines or one line with a thin rule). This is the page's headline, not a slogan on a poster in a museum. No extra body copy. No prices. No claims.

6. SLIM NAV in the sky/caption margin: top-left wordmark KONSTANZ in condensed geometric caps, cream or pine. Top-right or along the top edge of the sky plane: Discover  Explore  Weekend  Saved as small flat type, same geometric family. No search field. No hamburger. No buttons with fill/shadow. Nav sits IN the sky ink, like type printed on the poster plane.

MATERIALS: exactly four flat silkscreen inks only — teal #2A7A8C, pine #1F4A3C, ochre #C47A3A, cream stock #F3E6C8. Hard edges, slight ink overlap/misregistration allowed. No gradients, no neon glow, no glassmorphism, no drop shadows, no photography, no 3D, no skeuomorphic cards, no rounded UI cards, no search hero, no ticket UI, no login.

This must still read as a website homepage: the visitor understands they are looking at tonight in Konstanz on Bodensee and can read the four nights' doors from the promenade labels. WPA park-poster grammar used as the website layout system.

16:9 landscape, full-bleed first viewport, high fidelity, sharp type.
